name: delayvale_low_becomes_medium
purpose: Every item Low at the pipeline's 18 weeks, but the supplier has announced lead times four weeks longer (2026-10-25). At 22 weeks, BushingRing (36 weeks to stockout) is Medium (below 22 + 17 = 39); SealPlate (50 weeks) stays Low. Expected: the analysis raises the lead time, so the run does not end at the report: a purchase request and an email for BushingRing. Shows why the analysis runs even when every item is Low. Not part of the evaluation set.

history.text: DelayvaleParts announced that from April 2025 lead times for all products are four weeks longer while it replaces a production line; it expects this to last until the end of 2025.
